decisions.reason: The product shows a strong customer value result of more than €600,000 annual savings and remains on the website in 2024, so it likely exceeds aspiration levels and the growing firm has enough slack to retain it.

Although there is no quantified outcome reported, it stayed on its own page across 2023 and 2024 and fits closely with the firm’s established range, which makes continuation more likely than withdrawal.

As a flagship product line with a documented customer investment and strong quantified savings evidence, it appears clearly satisfactory relative to aspirations and strategically important to the firm’s direction.
This 2024 product line is close to the core business and the firm currently has growth and innovation slack, so absent visible failure management would likely give it more time on the market.

The new 2024 line builds on the established offer and matches the firm’s modular environmental-technology trajectory, so with organizational slack it is likely to be retained while results are still being learned.
